title: Design agent invariants project from one executable authority
statement: Generated design-agent manifests and design-governance audits project their invariant list from canon/invariants.jsonl; no second executable design-invariant list is permitted.

invariants.statement: Product source uses Inter and Satoshi only; serif media requires an exact approved exception.
Text Button size names share one equivalent 28px visible control, typography, and padding inside a 44px minimum hit target.
The marketing O-mark is visibly 32px and control-aligned.
Accent color communicates semantic state or a named data category, never decoration.
Decorative icons and emoji have no border, ring, circle, or badge plate.
One canonical component family owns a concept; supported states are variants consumed as instances.
Founder review contains canonical masters and intentional variants, without receipts, duplicates, or filler.
Pen is proposal/review evidence until source identity and required persistence receipts pass.
Logos normalize visible non-transparent ink through the shared asset registry, never route-local crop or scale CSS.
Never crop album art. Use object-fit: contain, not cover. No gradient, overlay, play button, or chrome on album art, merch, or a face except optional mostly-transparent glass play/pause.

A hero image is composed for its final layout: it reserves the headline, subcopy, header controls and product zones, and depth falls off optically from that focal plane like a wide-aperture 85mm portrait, never as a blur mask or a linear sharp-to-blur gradient.

Backgrounds are abstract light, atmosphere, restrained geometry, light leaks or low-detail texture. No literal spheres, glass balls, rings, props, stage lights, particle fields, visualizers, genre tropes, or texture that reads as a recognizable material. If the eye reaches the background before the copy or product, it fails.
Every text and control over imagery, including header Log in and the primary CTA, passes contrast in the rendered composition; the art direction reserves that contrast instead of a post-hoc overlay.
Every product page demonstrates the real product UI, callouts never overlap unintentionally, and no section below the hero ships as unstyled text.
A page has one hero; adjacent sections never restate the same introduction.

A marketing character ID is a defined person, not a prompt. Its passport fixes height, proportions, body type, hair, eyes, facial geometry and identifying traits. Casting boards use neutral comp-card framing and reject street or editorial selection; full-body views never crop heads. Selection passes premium aspirational quality and ICP resonance independently, then checks mouth, face, hair, build and presence for sibling duplication. An approved persona brief precedes generation. Character, wardrobe, environment, props, activity, camera, light, shadow and reflections form one physically coherent, aspirational commercial world; realistic never means average. Group scenes prioritize ICP fit and non-sensitive individuality without demographic tokenism or repeated high-signal styling. Models never name or resemble real people.

title: Overlays stack by one semantic layer contract and never collide
statement: Overlay primitives (sheet, dialog, alert dialog, popover, dropdown and context menus with submenus, select, tooltip, banner) stack by one semantic z-index contract: banner < sheet < modal < popover < tooltip, bound in @jovie/ui and never by raw numbers. A dialog opened from a sheet and a menu, select, or popover opened inside a dialog or sheet paint above it; Escape closes only the topmost overlay; modals trap focus and restore it to the originating control, including the trigger of a menu whose item opened the modal; modal scroll lock does not shift the page; nested submenus at any viewport edge stay inside the viewport and keep their parents open; a popover closes when its trigger or anchor unmounts; rapid open/close leaves no orphaned layer or pointer lock. New product source may not add raw z-index values above local stacking (z-30); grandfathered values only shrink.

title: Assurance matrix is the canonical coverage-of-coverage for critical failure classes

title: Founder design invariants are certification rules
statement: The eight founder-approved design invariants (JOV-6039) are durable certification rules for marketing surfaces and app UI, not prompt-only guidance: zero-or-one primary action, dominant-first hierarchy, progressive depth, route intent over product completeness, proximal route-specific proof, every section earns its place, no internal scaffolding in customer copy, and nav labels matching destination semantics. Deterministic rules run as fail-closed source gates; visual-semantic rules certify through the rendered-eval/taste corpus stream. A hard invariant failure blocks promotion, and founder-approved wording is carried verbatim — not silently reinterpreted.

rules.statement: Zero or one primary action per surface/section. A section does not need an action, but if it has one, there is exactly one primary action. The same principle applies inside product surfaces (page, rail, toolbar, etc.).

One dominant thing to perceive first. Visual hierarchy should be intentionally cinematic: the primary idea dominates; secondary information recedes substantially rather than competing at nearly equal weight.

Depth is progressive, not simultaneous. Keep default surfaces clean; reveal richer information through hover/popover/tooltips/drill-down where appropriate. Prefer information-dense visual primitives (icons, progress, etc.) over unnecessary text.

Route intent beats global product completeness. Copy and composition must be specific to the landing-page intent/ICP. A founder page should speak to founders; a developer page to developers; an artist claim/experiment page to that exact artist/use case. Never dilute a specific route merely to explain the entire product.
Claims need proximal, route-specific proof. Proof should support the promise being made on that route, not generic proof inserted mechanically.
Every section earns its place. No template filler or sections without a user-facing job.

Internal scaffolding must never become customer-facing copy. Component names, implementation notes, agent instructions, placeholders such as "proof kit," and other internal language are certification failures.

Navigation semantics must match destination semantics. Link/flyout labels may not misrepresent their targets (e.g. "Founders" cannot route to a CLI page). Machine certification should verify label/route intent alignment.

title: Design CI batch judge router routes every invariant x unit cell without guessing
statement: For every adopted invariant row (including each founder design rule exploded from a mixed-classification invariant) and every certifiable unit already declared in SCREEN_REGISTRY, MARKETING_COMPONENT_REGISTRY, APP_SCREEN_REGISTRY, or APP_SCREEN_COMPONENT_REGISTRY, the Design CI judge router computes applicability from each side's own existing scope/surface metadata and routes each applicable cell to exactly one judge -- deterministic, Jev, visual, or human. A cell whose judge cannot be determined from existing registry metadata is insufficient, never guessed toward the nearest-seeming judge. Persisted state (pass, fail, or insufficient) flows through the existing jovie.certification/v1 registry via a store-enforced skip-unless-changed fingerprint; the CLI never writes to Postgres directly and fails closed rather than silently skipping persistence when the evidence route or its secret is unavailable.

title: Escaped defects repair both product and detector before closure
statement: An escaped defect returns to Validating after a repair merge and remains non-Done until the originating issue carries machine-validated reproduction, product repair, exact deployed-build journey retest, detection-gap analysis, existing-learning-compiler output, reusable detector historical replay and live-verification proof, and bounded remediation evidence, or an explicit evidenced detector non-applicability disposition with independent verification. Merge is not activation. Automatic remediation has finite attempt, time, and spend budgets; exhaustion is an explicit blocked state with reason, owner, evidence, and next action.
